scripts.runtime:check: yarn workspace @aijee/engine check && yarn workspace aijee check
scripts.typecheck: yarn workspace @aijee/client-sdk typecheck && yarn exec tsc --noEmit -p apps/client/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: yarn workspace @aijee/client-sdk test && yarn workspace @aijee/ui test && yarn workspace @aijee/engine test && yarn workspace aijee test
scripts.api:generate: yarn workspace @aijee/api-contract generate && yarn workspace @aijee/client-sdk api:generate
scripts.web:build: yarn workspace @aijee/client build && node scripts/write-releases-snapshot.mjs && node scripts/prepare-web-assets.cjs
